name: Bible Study
tagline: Ivory paper, gold linework and teal scripture pills; an illuminated-manuscript teaching deck with click-to-read verse popups.
density: low on the slide, high behind the click

palette.description: ivory paper with soft radial glows; gold for titles and ornaments, teal for structure and scripture references, copper/peach number badges, crimson only for warning wording

typography.style: one classical serif for everything; centred titles between fading gold rules; verses at 23–32px on the slide and 48px in the popup

canvas: fixed 1920x1080, scaled to fit, absolutely positioned in px
best_for: Leading a group through key passages and questions: Bible studies, sermon outlines, Sunday-school and small-group lessons, any teaching talk where the slide shows the structure and the full text opens on click. Built for Chinese (Simplified) content; works for English with the same serif.
avoid_for: Data-heavy business decks, dark-room keynotes, or anything that needs charts and dense numbers.
navigation: inline engine: ←/→ PgUp/PgDn Space, Home/End, 1–9 jump, R reset, nav dots, swipe, #N deep link; print = one page per slide
source: generic teaching deck; all sample passages are placeholders
